newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Papaellinas sales up 20pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Greek Papaellinas sales up 20pct in Q1.

text.p: Sales of Greek cosmetics firm Papaellinas Group are up 20 percent year-on-year in the first quarter of 1997, it said in a statement on Monday.

"Sales in January-March have increased 20 percent over the respective period of 1997. The increase is attributed to market share growth as the group did not expand its product mix over the period in question," Papaellinas said.
Gross profit rose 33 percent, reflecting improved management of discounts and marketing of high-margin products, while operating expenses were five percent lower, it said.
The bottom line showed a 350 million drachma increase in the first quarter of 1997 over the same period a year earlier, Papaellinas said.
No comparative figures for the first quarter of 1996 were disclosed.
Papaellinas will distribute a dividend per share of 100 drachmas for fiscal 1996. It distributed a dividend per share of 160 drachmas for fiscal 1995 to the pre-IPO number of shares.
On a consolidated basis, Papaellinas' pretax earnings rose 13 percent to 1.5 billion drachmas in 1996 on turnover growth of eight percent to 14.2 billion drachmas.
Management forecast sales of 15.3 billion in 1997.
Papaelinas' stock firmed 75 drachmas to 1,805 on Monday on heavy volume of 93,620 shares. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
